protocol.purpose: Implement E101s predeclared natural-development and original-winning-route checks. No new learning hypothesis, fit, search policy, seed draw or hyperparameter choice.
protocol.prerequisites: All E99 natural sources and original development gate, E100 complete joint labels, both E101 fits, and independent common-heldout native-choice verification. Only arms with common-heldout net>=20 and exact paired p<.05 can start natural games.
protocol.natural_gate: Each admitted arm runs every same assigned512 seed from natural A20 Ironclad start. Require net>=10 Heart wins and exact paired p<.05 against the repaired-engine fixed parent; zero faults; all terminal/state/RNG/timing checks; first changed action in the two declared scopes; independent stored-weight arithmetic audit of every outside choice; identical fresh MCTS/NN replan of every winner. Retain early failures, and reject missing/invalid results without replacement or retries.
protocol.original_selection: For each arm passing the natural screen, execute every Heart-winning development route in ascending seed order using one owned isolated original JVM. No winner subset, cached-route substitution, retries or resynchronization. Stop at the first nonmatch/fault/deadline, retain all unattempted routes, and block selection.
protocol.original_verification: Inherited E99 original per-route implementation and all comparators, plus six persistent RNG streams and independent command/identity/keys/two distinct Act3 bosses/Act4/Heart/cleanup audit. Candidate source is its complete audited natural cohort with the candidate model, identity and frozen loader/runtime, not the parent model.
protocol.candidate_selection: Only after every natural-passing arms complete original gate: more Heart wins, fewer lost parent wins, then small on a tie. The result is a development-screened frozen candidate; no production adoption or unseen evaluation in these commands.
protocol.unchanged_game_inputs: E98 engine; fixed parent192 encoder; MCTS8000 and boss multiplier3; existing E54 search and 256 replan cap; deterministic45 seconds/floor and one transform preview frame; no Prismatic Shard purchase; no new optimizers.
protocol.limits: Preparation software checks do not establish a learned gain, original candidate parity or50percent success. Final acceptance needs a later frozen selected checkpoint and1024 genuinely unseen seed families.

terminal_hp_rejected.reason: natural replay terminal state or RNG differs

preserved_checker_error.cause: The terminal verifier correctly rejected the altered HP with ValueError; the checking script expected AssertionError.
preserved_checker_error.correction: Catch the verifier's documented ValueError for this one negative control and use a separate second probe directory. No formal controller, original comparator, runtime, model, game input or expectation changed.

limits: Software entry/selection/whole-route audit controls on the known E98 parent route with a zero-head fixture; no learned candidate or original cohort validation.
